name: Orange vest
why: Other hunters can see you better in the trees.
tip: Put it on before you leave the truck.

name: Hunting boots
why: They help on mud, rocks, and long walks.
tip: Wear them around the house first so they do not hurt.

name: Backpack
why: You need something to carry water, food, and extra clothes.
tip: Pack light. You will be walking a lot.

name: Water bottle
why: You get tired fast if you do not drink enough water.
tip: Bring more than you think you need.

name: First aid kit
why: Small cuts and blisters happen outdoors.
tip: Check it once a year and replace old items.

name: Flashlight
why: It gets dark fast in the woods.
tip: Keep extra batteries in your bag.

name: Map or GPS
why: Easy to get turned around in a new area.
tip: Learn the map before you go, not only on your phone.

name: Rain jacket
tip: A light jacket fits in any backpack.

name: Warm gloves
why: Cold hands make it hard to handle gear safely.
tip: Bring a thin pair and a thicker pair if it is winter.

name: Hunting knife
why: Useful for small tasks in the field.
tip: Keep the blade covered when you are not using it.

name: Binoculars
why: Help you spot animals from far away.

name: Game bags
why: Clean way to carry meat after a successful hunt.
tip: Keep them in a dry spot in your pack.

name: Headlamp
why: Frees your hands when walking in the dark.
tip: Red light mode saves battery and does not scare animals as much.

name: Whistle
why: Loud signal if you get lost or need help.
tip: Attach it to your backpack strap.

name: Fire starter
why: Warmth and a signal if you are stuck outside longer than planned.
tip: Practice starting a fire before you depend on it.
